answer: Picture reputation as an orchard: each agent must plant a costly, non-refundable stake-bond that only bears fruit through honest work accumulated slowly over many epochs. A sybil attacker gains nothing, because every freshly minted fake identity is an isolated island with no history and no peers willing to vouch. Trust is earned like polishing one marble smooth by hand, verifiable and non-transferable, so spinning up a thousand cheap identities buys no weight the market will price.
